## Current and recent courses

### [NRES 800: Data Science for Natural Resources](https://bulletin.unl.edu/courses/NRES/800)

Graduate course in data science for natural resources. View the [NRES 800 class slides](https://chrischizinski.com/nres800-slides/).

### [NRES 315: Human Dimensions of Wildlife and Fisheries](https://bulletin.unl.edu/courses/NRES/315)

An introduction to the theory and methods used to understand human dimensions, with applications and case studies in fisheries and wildlife management. View the [NRES 315 class slides](https://chrischizinski.com/nres315-slides/).

### [Guest Lectures](https://chrischizinski.github.io/nres-801-guest-lectures/)

Guest lectures organized by course and year, beginning with NRES 801.
